notes: Factual fix: Crescent Strike has no root or any CC — Riot's text says damage plus Moonlight reveal; both content claims ('Crescent Strike roots', 'Crescent Strike root') replaced with the real mechanic (mark makes Lunar Rush cooldown-free). Level chart: full layer blanket 'Skill' moved to match packet and content (Sylas/Skill/Sylas/Skill/Diana/Diana/Sylas) with rewritten whys and ratings. Packet suspectNames are all false positives (verb/possessive forms of real names Lunar Rush, Chain Lash, Pale Cascade). 'Double Pale Cascade shields' in spikes[1] kept as shorthand for the third-orb bonus shield strength (kit-grounded). Shared tradeGood string corrected in all three copies to avoid desync.
